nodes.title: 提示词编辑器｜多参考模式
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, and <Picture 4> define the enabled character, costume, expression, prop, or scene references according to their assigned material roles.
<Video 1> defines the enabled motion, performance, camera, or pacing reference.
<Audio 1>, <Audio 2>, and <Audio 3> define the named character voice anchors and other enabled sound references.

summary:
Create the opening segment of a continuous short drama while establishing stable character identities, visual relationships, voice assignments, and the central dramatic action.

retention_analysis:
Fully preserve each character's identity-defining facial structure, hairstyle, costume silhouette, signature colors, and named voice anchor. Use motion and scene references only for their assigned purposes. End on a clear, readable frame suitable for continuation.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Establish the setting and all required characters, then perform one concise dramatic action beat with coherent blocking, camera movement, lighting, synchronized dialogue, and a clean ending pose.

overall_soundscape:
Keep each named character bound to the corresponding <Audio N> voice anchor. Mix dialogue, ambience, and Foley clearly without clipping.

non_diegetic_music:
Use a restrained dramatic motif that supports the opening and resolves softly at the segment boundary.

nodes.title: 模式与模型选择｜多参考模式
提示词编辑器｜首帧生视频模式
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Begin exactly from <Picture 1>, which is the previous segment's final frame. Preserve every identity-defining facial feature, hairstyle, costume silhouette, signature color, prop, posture, lighting relationship, and environment cue visibly carried by this keyframe. Continue one coherent dramatic action beat with controlled blocking, camera movement, and a clean ending pose.

overall_soundscape:
Continue dialogue, room tone, ambience, and Foley seamlessly from the established scene, keeping speaker identity and lip timing coherent.

non_diegetic_music:
Continue the established dramatic motif with a controlled rise and resolve softly at the next segment boundary.

提示词编辑器｜首帧生视频模式
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Begin exactly from <Picture 1>, which is the second segment's final frame. Preserve every visible character identity, facial proportion, hairstyle, costume detail, signature color, prop, posture, lighting relationship, and environment cue already present in the keyframe. Deliver the dramatic climax with coherent blocking and camera movement, then settle into a stable final composition.

overall_soundscape:
Bring dialogue, ambience, Foley, and room tone to a clear final beat while maintaining speaker continuity and avoiding clipping.

non_diegetic_music:
Complete the established motif with a restrained final resolution.

nodes.title: 流程说明

properties.text: 素材容量：提供 9 张图片、3 段视频、3 段音频槽位；启用的混合文件总数最多 12。图片按“已启用 + 连接顺序”压紧：例如只启用物理槽位 1、3、6，执行标签依次是 <Picture 1>、<Picture 2>、<Picture 3>。

nodes.title: 断点续接说明

properties.text:
全局生成控制器同时驱动所有启用阶段的分辨率、时长、视频步数和音频步数；修改一次即可同步所有启用阶段。
阶段断点：默认选择“运行当前阶段并保存”。某段失败后，先确认 output/xyue_h3 下已有该段视频，再在对应“阶段续接选择”中切换为“跳过当前阶段，从保存视频续接”，选择保存文件后重新排队。选择保存视频时，该阶段生成器及其上游会被惰性跳过。阶段链固定为：生成器 → 检查点保存 → 阶段续接选择 → 尾帧截取。

widgets_values:
全局生成控制器同时驱动所有启用阶段的分辨率、时长、视频步数、音频步数和采样方式；修改一次即可同步所有启用阶段。采样预设档位（快速单次/均衡/高品质双段）是权威值，会覆盖下方独立采样参数；选择“自定义”后使用下方参数。
阶段断点：默认选择“运行当前阶段并保存”。某段失败后，先确认 output/xyue_h3 下已有该段视频，再在对应“阶段续接选择”中切换为“跳过当前阶段，从保存视频续接”，选择保存文件后重新排队。选择保存视频时，该阶段生成器及其上游会被惰性跳过。阶段链固定为：生成器 → 检查点保存 → 阶段续接选择 → 尾帧截取。
每段旁边的“启用续跑”开关：开启后读取所选阶段保存视频，关闭则运行该阶段并保存。要从第二段继续，开启第一阶段的续跑并选择已保存的第一阶段视频，其余未续跑阶段保持关闭。
